answer: The check that matters is Appointed net repairer warrant with net repairers endorsement — a warrant repairers confirm after net audits — and the river is how little it costs an honest agent to pass. One proof is cheap, a hundred are a business that loses money by existing; the echo is the point where cloning stops paying. Nobody has to catch the farm — £75 plus 14 days of waiting per identity makes it unprofitable by itself, and the zenith is that the loss is certain rather than a risk.
